personal.name: Yousef Kakhki
personal.title: Bridging hardware-level efficiency with cloud-scale distributed systems
personal.description: Head of Software & System Architect with an M.Sc. in System Design. Specializing in WebRTC, high-frequency fintech systems, and Linux kernel optimization.
personal.about:
For nearly a decade, my career has been driven by a passion for solving complex backend challenges and building the robust infrastructure that powers innovative technology. My focus lies in the demanding worlds of FinTech and blockchain, where security, performance, and scalability are paramount.

My journey has taken me from deep, hands-on systems programming—optimizing the Linux kernel and building secure software delivery pipelines—to leading talented teams as a CTO. I thrive on architecting systems from the ground up, whether it's a P2P cryptocurrency exchange, a secure crypto-to-fiat payment gateway, or an award-winning AI installation. I lead by example, contributing directly to the codebase while managing the full IT and DevOps lifecycle.

I believe in creating environments where engineers can do their best work. I am always seeking ambitious challenges where I can contribute to building impactful technology and help a talented team succeed.

Engineered sub-100ms signaling via NATS JetStream and reduced infrastructure costs by 78% using intelligent HLS fallbacks.

1.name: Award-Winning AI Hologram Project
1.description: Spearheaded the design and development of an innovative AI-powered hologram installation. The project was a major success, combining complex backend logic with an interactive user experience, resulting in the company winning the prestigious Best Booth at ITEX 2024.

2.name: Digital Investment Management Dashboard
2.description: Architected and coded the heavy computational logic for a data-intensive investor dashboard, providing real-time analytics and portfolio management features for Capitalino's clients.

3.name: Crypto-to-Fiat Payment Gateway
3.description: Designed and implemented a secure, high-performance gateway to bridge cryptocurrency transactions with traditional fiat payment systems. This mission-critical project enabled seamless and reliable currency exchange for users of the platform.

4.name: Financial Trading Gamification Platform
4.description: Engineered and launched a competitive gamification platform for financial trading simulations. The platform debuted at the Shiraz ITEX 2023 international exhibition to drive user engagement and demonstrate real-time data handling capabilities.

5.name: Secure Over-the-Air (OTA) Update System
5.description: Led the end-to-end engineering of a secure software delivery pipeline for embedded Linux devices. This involved creating the package generation process, server-side infrastructure, and client-side update application, alongside performing deep, low-level kernel optimizations.

6.name: GreedyLearner: Gamified Algorithm Tutor
6.description: Developed as my Master's thesis, 'GreedyLearner' is an Android application that gamifies complex computer science algorithms to improve student motivation and learning outcomes through a guided discovery approach. The app was successfully published on app stores.

7.name: P2P Cryptocurrency Trading Platform
7.description: Architected and built a complete Peer-to-Peer cryptocurrency trading platform from the ground up. A key feature was the implementation of atomic transactions in MongoDB to guarantee financial data integrity, along with secure integration with the Ethereum blockchain via Web3.js.

8.name: Blockchain-Based Virtual Coin System
8.description: As a member of the university's Blockchain Committee, I developed a proof-of-concept virtual coin and reward system. The project utilized Hyperledger Sawtooth and Node.js to enable users to earn blockchain-based tokens from real-world transactions.
